Jun Watanabe is a Machine Learning Engineer at NexaGame Studios. We collaborated on optimizing player retention through NLP-driven sentiment analysis.  

Jun’s NLP work on player feedback classification reduced moderation time by 40% and boosted feature prioritization accuracy by 25%. He built a recommendation system that increased in-game purchases by 18% during beta, using PyTorch and REST APIs to sync with game servers. His MLOps pipeline, built with MLflow and Weights & Biases, cut deployment latency by 30% and slashed monitoring costs by 22% through automated logging.  

Jun thrives in tight deadlines. When Kubernetes clusters failed during a live event, he rerouted workloads to Docker containers in 2 hours, avoiding $5k in cloud costs. His computer vision project for character animation reduced manual tweaking by 60%, using lightweight models optimized for low-latency environments.  

Jun’s reliability and curiosity make him a standout. He’ll ask pointed questions about data quality and push for cost-aware solutions—always balancing innovation with operational constraints.
